games.name: Combat Arena
games.desc:
Combat Arena is a fast-paced arcade style FPS where participants face off in a variety of arenas set in locations from around the world to earn coins and glory!

💥 Knock out other players with a wide variety of weapons and unlock devastatingly powerful streaks!
🪙 Earn coins to unlock new weapons!
🖌️ Open crates to have a chance at legendary skins and more!
💵 Sell or trade items you collect with other players!
📱 Play with your friends on PC, console, or a smartphone with full native cross-platform compatibility!

If you encounter any exploiters, please report them in the community server. Proof of exploiting will result in a ban from the game.

The Cube awaits a new champion.

games.name: Blood Zone 🎃
games.desc:
💥 Have some fun in this awesome FFA pvp shooter game!

🩸 Step foot into this game, it's just pure chaos. Just kill, kill, and kill. Customize your character with some fashion as you mow your enemies down! Also features a large catalog of weapons and secrets to put your grubby little hands on!

✅ MAKE SURE to turn blood on in the settings for the full experience
❌ Do NOT farm for kills / deaths for an unfair advantage, it is a punishable offense!

Most Recent Update:

🎃 The Halloween event is here! Search for golden pumpkin and special candies to earn limited rewards!
✨ Use code "halloween2026" for a free skin!

👍 Remember to like and favorite!

games.name: Project: Afternight
games.desc:
[ ⚠️ THIS IS A BETA RELEASE! This game is still in active development, and not fully polished. ]
[ ⚠️ WARNING: This game has flashing lights, screen shakes and jumpscares! ]

Beatbox game, what else?

Project: Afternight is a casual, heavily customizable rhythm game inspired by Friday Night Funkin' (FNF), and its mods, with content from other games/media available as well. 
Get on a speaker to battle other players on nearly 4,000 different songs across several difficulties.

Best played on desktop, but mobile and console are also supported.
Join the community for news and sneak peeks!

- Credits to The Funkin' Crew for the original Friday Night Funkin' assets.
- Credits to various mod authors & musicians used can be seen in-game.

This game is not associated with SEGA, Konami, Behaviour Interactive, Ghost Ship Games, Steel Wool Studios, Ubisoft, Epic Games, EA, Capcom, Project Moon or any other brands mentioned in-game. All rights go to the mentioned.

games.name: Blackout: Revival [FREE ZOMBIES]
games.desc:
Welcome to Blackout: Revival
This is your hub, the gateway to two distinct operations in a world hanging by a thread. Choose, gear up, and push back against the collapse.

Final Eclipse
A class-based roguelite survival mode where you build strength each run and face endless waves of corruption.

Killzone [EARLY ACCESS]
A dynamic looter shooter set in a fractured world ruled by factions and shifting power. Scavenge what you can, adapt to changing conditions, and complete high-risk tasks across an evolving battlefield.
(Join the group for an extra 10 stash capacity in Killzone)

games.name: [Tempest King 👑 + Summer 🏖️] Anime Apocalypse
games.desc:
⚠️ [BETA RELEASE] — Expect frequent updates, new content & balance tweaks. Found a bug or got feedback? Join our community and help shape the game!

Welcome to Anime Apocalypse!
Anime Apocalypse is a fast-paced Anime dungeon hack-and-slash zombie game! Fight through zombie filled dungeons, obtain unique abilities, and play unique gamemodes!

Will you survive the Apocalypse?

⚔️ Hack-and-Slash Action
💥 Unique Anime Abilities
🏃 Unique Parkour Movement
🎯 Pets, Loadouts & More!

🎮 Controls
M1 — LMB / X / Square
Skill 1 — Z / L2 / LT
Skill 2 — X / L1 / LB
Skill 3 — C / R1 / RB
Skill 4 — V / R2 / RT
Gadget — E / D-Pad Up
Ultimate — G / D-Pad Down
Dash — Q / B / Circle
Slide — Ctrl / Y / Triangle

games.name: Hooked! [TRAIT]
games.desc:
⚡ In this relentless game of precision, positioning, and teamwork, your survival depends on a single weapon: the Hook. Grapple enemies to pull them out of position, or strike them down in intense team-versus-team arena battles. Every throw can turn the tide of war!

🔥 Claim victory to earn coins and build your ultimate loadout. Test your luck to roll for legendary Hook skins, and unlock game-changing abilities. Strategy is key—you can only equip ONE ability per match, so choose wisely to complement your team's playstyle!

🏆 Coordinate with your allies or carry the match! Whether you are a tactical mastermind or a casual brawler, the arena awaits.

Tags: minigame, team battle, pvp, multiplayer, abilities, grappling hook, action, combat, mobile, console, xbox, pc

games.name: San Aurie
games.desc:
San Aurie is an open-world roleplay simulator that mixes emergency services, criminal, and civilian life.

👮 Catch criminals and respond to emergencies.
🏁 Race players, play mini golf, or hit the arcade.
💎 Rob houses, steal cars, or stage heists.
🏠 Drive cars and bikes, customize homes, sail boats, and raise pets.
🔥 Tackle fires, rescue people, tow cars, or deliver goods and food.

Directed by EmesOfficial

games.name: Break In 2 (Story)
games.desc:
A family lost with no help in sight,
rain, hail and thunder made an unpleasant night,
they took to the forest for shelter from harm,
but the tall trees above could not keep them calm,
they travelled along, their aching legs tired,
their hope for a rest had almost expired,
but there, in the distance! A wonderful find!
A building, abandoned, surely no one would mind?
They ventured forth, they knew what to do,
it was finally time for Break In 2.
